text: You'll wait almost half an hour to get to a boil that makes the whistle blow.. Don't like NEEDING to use the trivet on an electric stove, It's cute and folksy but for a few dollars more you can have one a little more durable and safe. You MUST remove the 'whistle top' to pour.. you have to do it carefully or the steam will burn you. Don't like that it takes so looooooong to boil on medium. Almost half an hour on an electric stove.
